ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 90% high-intensity white pixels occupying the central and medial regions, and 10% low-intensity black pixels localized to the trailing edge perimeter and median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white macro-blob covering the majority of both lobes. Fine black contiguous banding (line width 5-15 pixels) follows the contour of the trailing edge. Minimal brownish/yellowish low-saturation mottling is present in the medial-left and medial-right quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 55 degrees; vertex depth extends significantly toward the peduncle connection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (peaks ranging 3-10 pixels in height) distributed along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased irregularity and depth toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to acute, upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, high-texture clusters of white and grey circular pixel groups (barnacle colonization) located at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, vertical and diagonal low-contrast brownish linear disruptions (scratches) visible on the white ventral surface of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the fluke tips; small irregular notches or 'chips' in the trailing edge serration that deviate from the rhythmic pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high percentage of white pigmentation (Type 1 fluke categorization) with minimal black pigmentation encroachment from the trailing edge.
